name_ar: كتابة العربية على الصور بـ Pillow
name_en: Arabic text on images with Pillow (raqm)
what: Pillow 12 يشكّل العربية بنفسه عبر raqm؛ أمرّر النص كما هو مع الاتجاه واللغة ونقطة الارتكاز. — Pillow 12 shapes Arabic itself through raqm; pass the text as-is with direction, language and anchor.
when: thumbnails, social cards, certificates, OCR test images, labels on frames
how: f=ImageFont.truetype(path,64,layout_engine=ImageFont.Layout.RAQM); draw.text((right_x,y), text, font=f, direction='rtl', language='ar', anchor='ra'). Check PIL.features.check('raqm') first (True, raqm 0.10.5, on 2026-10-16). Use bundled OFL fonts (Amiri, Cairo, Tajawal) because system Arabic fonts are poor.
params: anchor 'ra' = right edge, ascender line; 'la' for LTR
section: النص العربي على الصور — Arabic text on images

what: إضافة arabic_reshaper وpython-bidi فوق محرك يشكّل بنفسه تقلب الكلمات وتفصل الحروف. — Adding arabic_reshaper + python-bidi on top of an engine that already shapes reverses the words and breaks the letters.
when: old snippets with get_display(reshape(s)); text appears reversed
how: Rule: raw string for raqm/HarfBuzz engines (Pillow 12, matplotlib 3.11, browsers, LibreOffice, weasyprint); reshape + bidi only for reportlab or builds without raqm. Contact panel 4 shows both lines side by side.
section: النص العربي على الصور — Arabic text on images

name_ar: التعرف على العربية والإنجليزية بـ tesseract
what: أستخرج النص العربي والإنجليزي من الصور محليًا بعد تثبيت حزمة العربية. — Extract Arabic and English text from images locally once the Arabic pack is installed.
when: screenshots, scans, photos of documents, images inside PDFs
how: apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-ara (6 s); pytesseract.image_to_string(img, lang='ara+eng', config='--oem 1 --psm 6'). Proof: clean naskh, sans and English lines read at similarity 0.99 in 0.41 s; mean word confidence 90.6. Strip U+200E/U+200F marks from the output.
params: --psm 6 block, 7 single line, 4 columns; 300 dpi for scans
install: apt-get install tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-ara && pip install pytesseract

name_en: Arabic OCR weak spots (digits, display fonts)
what: نموذج ara الافتراضي يخطئ في الأرقام الهندية العربية والخطوط الكوفية والعرضية؛ أتحقق من كل رقم. — The stock ara model misreads Arabic-Indic digits and Kufi/display fonts; validate every number.
when: invoices, phone numbers, dates, prices read by OCR
how: Measured (56 px, psm 7): Arabic-Indic digits 0.51-0.84 similarity (a phone number came back as garbage); the same line with Western digits 1.0; Reem Kufi merged two words. Mitigations: -l ara for pure Arabic lines (ara+eng can emit Latin junk); range/checksum checks; ask the user to confirm numbers; try tessdata_best (untested).

what: أقدّر زاوية الميل من كتل السطور وأدوّر الصورة قبل التعرف، فيرتفع التطابق كثيرًا. — Estimate the skew angle from line blobs and rotate before OCR; accuracy rises sharply.
when: photographed or scanned pages that are visibly tilted
how: median 3 -> Otsu (inverted) -> morph open 2x2 -> dilate with a 60x5 kernel -> contours > 5000 px -> cv2.minAreaRect angles (subtract 90 when w<h) -> median -> warpAffine back. Proof: true 12°, estimated 12.07°, OCR 0.598 -> 0.912.

name_en: Measure preprocessing, do not assume it helps
what: التحويل إلى أبيض وأسود بعتبة تكيفية خفّض دقة tesseract 5 بعد التقويم؛ كل خطوة تُقاس. — Adaptive-threshold binarisation lowered tesseract 5 accuracy after deskew; measure every step.
when: building any OCR or image pipeline
how: Score each variant against ground truth (difflib ratio on NFKC text). Proof: grayscale deskew 0.912, the same plus adaptiveThreshold(31, C=15) 0.814. Tesseract's LSTM engine works on grayscale; binarise only if a measurement shows it helps.

what: تعرّف ضوئي يدعم العربية دون apt، لكنه يسحب torch ونماذج. — OCR with Arabic support and no apt step, but it pulls torch and model files.
when: hosts without apt/root
how: pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu (21 s, 769 MB in the arsenal run) then pip install easyocr; reader=easyocr.Reader(['ar','en']). Model download and accuracy not tested here.

what: حواف، وعتبات، وتدوير، وتحويلات منظور، وكشف أشكال — أساس أي خط معالجة صور. — Edges, thresholds, rotation, perspective warps and contours: the base of any image pipeline.
when: cleanup, measurement, masks, document straightening
how: cv2.Canny(gray,80,160); cv2.threshold(..., THRESH_OTSU); cv2.getRotationMatrix2D + warpAffine(borderValue=255); cv2.findContours. Note: opencv-python-headless is version 5.0 (major bump), so check the API before writing code.

what: أختار الصيغة بالأرقام: WebP وAVIF أصغر بكثير من PNG وJPEG مع SSIM مرتفع. — Choose formats by numbers: WebP and AVIF are much smaller than PNG/JPEG while keeping SSIM high.
when: web images, thumbnails, artifacts under size limits
how: Pillow save: PNG optimize, WebP quality 80, AVIF quality 50, JPEG 85; measure with cv2.PSNR and skimage structural_similarity(channel_axis=2). Proof (640x480 synthetic): 12.0 / 5.5 / 3.3 / 15.8 KB; WebP PSNR 39.7 dB, SSIM 0.982.

what: أستخرج الألوان الغالبة من صورة أو شعار لبناء هوية أو مطابقة تصميم. — Extract dominant colours from an image or logo to build or match a palette.
when: brand matching, palette from a photo, colour grading references
how: Z=img.reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32); cv2.kmeans(Z, k, None, (EPS+MAX_ITER,30,0.5), 4, cv2.KMEANS_PP_CENTERS); sort centres by cluster size. Proof: k=4 recovered three disc colours within 0.9-2.3 RGB units. Gradients need a larger k or a LAB colour space.

what: أولّد رموز QR (حتى بروابط فيها عربية) وأفك ترميزها للتحقق، وأولّد باركود EAN/Code128. — Generate QR codes (even URLs with Arabic) and decode them back to verify; generate EAN/Code128 barcodes.
when: menus, posters, invoices, packaging, end cards
how: qrcode.make(payload, box_size=8, border=4).save(p); cv2.QRCodeDetector().detectAndDecode(cv2.imread(p)) must equal the payload. Barcode: barcode.get('ean13', digits, writer=ImageWriter()).save('bc').

what: تحويلات سريعة للصور من الطرفية؛ الإصدار المتوفر 6 (convert) لا 7 (magick). — Quick image transforms from the shell; the available version is 6 (`convert`), not 7 (`magick`).
when: batch resize, format conversion, montage, quick fixes
how: convert in.png -resize 50% -colorspace Gray -unsharp 0x1 out.png; identify -format '%w %h %[colorspace]' out.png -> 750 235 Gray (proof). Use mogrify for in-place batches on copies only.

what: أحوّل رسوم SVG إلى صور نقطية لإدراجها في مستندات أو فيديو. — Rasterise SVG for documents or video.
when: icons, logos, diagrams drawn as SVG
how: cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=svg, write_to='o.png', output_width=1024). For Arabic text inside SVG prefer Chromium rendering (APP-05 snap) because it has full shaping; Arabic in cairosvg was not tested.

name_en: Look at your own outputs (vision QA)
what: أفتح الصور وصفحات PDF التي أنتجتها بأداة القراءة وأراها فعلًا قبل الادعاء بأنها صحيحة. — Open the images and PDF pages I produced with the Read tool and actually look before claiming they are right.
when: after every render, chart, document or OCR test image
how: Build a contact sheet (Pillow tiles, quantize to stay under 300 KB), Read it, and check Arabic joining, direction, cropping and overlaps. In this session, looking caught a reversed matplotlib title, a chart split over two pages, and a wrong filter name.

what: أصنع صوتًا معروف الخصائص (نغمة، صمت، نقرات بإيقاع) لاختبار أي خط معالجة. — Make audio with known properties (tone, silence, clicks at a tempo) to test any audio pipeline.
when: before trusting a beat, pitch, loudness or silence detector on real audio
how: numpy: 0.2*sin(2*pi*440*t) for 2 s, zeros for 1 s, decaying 1 kHz clicks every 0.5 s (120 BPM); soundfile.write(p, sig, 48000, subtype='PCM_16').

what: أقيس التردد الأساسي لصوت أو نغمة. — Measure the fundamental frequency of a voice or tone.
when: tuning checks, voice analysis, verifying generated tones
how: f0=librosa.yin(y, fmin=100, fmax=1000, sr=sr); np.median(f0). Proof: 440 Hz tone -> 440.6 Hz. librosa is 1.0 now; check the API before writing from memory.

what: أجد لحظات الضربات والمسافات بينها لاستنتاج الإيقاع. — Find hit times and their spacing to infer tempo.
when: cutting to the beat, syncing captions, rhythm checks
how: librosa.onset.onset_detect(y=seg, sr=sr, units='time'); tempo = 60/median(diff). Start the window about 0.1 s before the first hit, because an onset at sample 0 is missed (first run found 5 of 6). Proof: 6 onsets, 0.501 s spacing (119.7 BPM).

what: أقيس الجهارة المتكاملة بطريقتين مستقلتين (pyloudnorm وffmpeg ebur128) وأتحقق من اتفاقهما. — Measure integrated loudness two independent ways (pyloudnorm, ffmpeg ebur128) and check that they agree.
when: delivering voice-overs, podcasts, reels, music beds
how: pyln.Meter(sr).integrated_loudness(x); ffmpeg -i f -af ebur128=peak=true -f null - (read the last 'I:'). Proof: -13.96 vs -13.9 LUFS on the normalised file.

name_en: Two-pass linear loudnorm to a target
what: أرفع الصوت إلى −14 LUFS بكسب ثابت دون ضغط، وأتأكد أن ffmpeg لم ينتقل سرًا إلى الوضع الديناميكي. — Bring audio to -14 LUFS with pure gain (no compression), and confirm ffmpeg did not silently switch to dynamic mode.
when: final audio for any delivery; preserving the user's audio character
how: Pass 1: loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11:print_format=json -f null. Pass 2: the measured_* values + offset + linear=true + print_format=json, and LRA set above the measured LRA (max(11, input_lra+1)); assert normalization_type == 'linear'. Proof: -18.05 -> -13.96 LUFS, linear. With LRA=11 and a measured LRA of 17.8 the mode went dynamic.
params: I -14, TP -1 dBTP; streaming platforms vary (-14 to -16)

what: أجد فترات الصمت لقصها أو لتقسيم المقاطع. — Find silent stretches to trim them or split segments.
when: podcast cleanup, splitting takes, jump cuts
how: ffmpeg -i f -af silencedetect=noise=-50dB:d=0.5 -f null - ; parse silence_start / silence_end. Proof: 2.0 -> 3.0 s found exactly. Tune noise to the room tone (-35 to -50 dB).

what: أرسم شكل الموجة والطيف لصوت لعرضه أو لفحصه بالعين. — Draw a waveform and a spectrogram of audio to show or inspect it.
when: podcast covers, QA of edits, explaining audio
how: ffmpeg -i f -filter_complex showwavespic=s=1200x200:colors=#2a78d6 -frames:v 1 w.png ; ffmpeg -i f -lavfi showspectrumpic=s=1200x300:legend=0 s.png. The filter is showwavespic; there is no 'showwavespng' (the first run failed on that name).

name_en: Slice, fade and export with pydub (Python 3.13)
what: تحرير صوتي بسيط بالمللي ثانية؛ على بايثون 3.13 يحتاج حزمة audioop-lts. — Simple millisecond audio editing; on Python 3.13 it needs the audioop-lts package.
when: trimming intros, fades, joining clips, exporting MP3
how: pip install pydub audioop-lts (without it: ModuleNotFoundError 'pyaudioop'); AudioSegment.from_wav(p)[:2000].fade_in(200).fade_out(400).export('o.mp3', format='mp3', bitrate='128k'). Proof: ffprobe 2.040 s (the MP3 encoder adds padding).

what: أحوّل إلى AAC أو MP3 وأتحقق بـ ffprobe أن المدة لم تتغير. — Transcode to AAC or MP3 and verify with ffprobe that the duration did not change.
when: delivering audio for web, messaging or video
how: ffmpeg -i in.wav -c:a aac -b:a 96k out.m4a; ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 out.m4a. Proof: 6.000 s for a 6.0 s source, 34 KB (MP3 via pydub: 2.040 s for 2.0 s, encoder padding). Never overwrite the user's original.

what: ضاغط وصدى وفلاتر بجودة استوديو من Python؛ الرخصة GPL. — Studio-grade compressor, reverb and filters from Python; licensed GPL.
when: polishing a voice-over or music bed (use as a tool, do not vendor it)
how: Pedalboard([Compressor(), Reverb()])(audio, sr) (arsenal run). Keep the original and render a copy.

what: تفريغ الكلام العربي بطوابع زمنية للكلمات على المعالج بنماذج صغيرة. — Transcribe Arabic speech with word timestamps on CPU using small models.
when: captions, words.json for sync, meeting notes
how: pip install faster-whisper; WhisperModel('small', device='cpu', compute_type='int8').transcribe(p, language='ar', word_timestamps=True). Models download from huggingface.co (reachable on 2026-10-16). Not run in this proof; see the motion audio-sync family for the caption pipeline.

what: فصل الصوت البشري عن الموسيقى؛ بطيء على المعالج. — Separate vocals from music; slow on CPU.
when: remove music under speech, karaoke, remix
how: pip install demucs (needs torch); demucs --two-stems=vocals in.wav. Expect minutes per track without a GPU. Not run here.
section: خدمات وأدوات ثقيلة — Services & heavy tools

what: قص الشخص أو المنتج من الخلفية بنموذج U2Net محلي. — Cut out a person or product from the background with a local U2Net model.
when: product shots, thumbnails, stickers
how: pip install rembg; rembg i in.png out.png. The model downloads on first use; not tested here. The paid service alternative is MEDIA-29.

what: قراءة وحذف بيانات الكاميرا والموقع قبل النشر. — Read and strip camera and GPS metadata before publishing.
when: privacy before sharing photos; checking capture dates
how: Pillow: Image.open(p).getexif(); strip by re-saving without exif. Full tool: apt-get install libimage-exiftool-perl; exiftool -all= copy.jpg. Not run here.

name_ar: توليد وتحسين الصور والأصوات بالذكاء الاصطناعي (مدفوع)
name_en: AI image/audio generation and upscaling (paid connector)
what: عند وجود موصل مثل Higgsfield: توليد صور وصوت، وتكبير، وإزالة خلفية، ودبلجة — بأرصدة مدفوعة وبطلب صريح. — With a connector such as Higgsfield: image and audio generation, upscaling, background removal, dubbing; it costs credits, so only on explicit request.
when: the user explicitly asks for generated or upscaled media and the connector is attached
how: Check the tool list for mcp__<server>__generate_image / upscale_image / remove_background / dubbing; read the connector's own instructions; quote the cost first; never call paid tools without the user's intent. No GPU locally, so local diffusion is impractical.
section: خدمات وأدوات ثقيلة — Services & heavy tools

what: فتح صور الآيفون بصيغة HEIC وتحويلها. — Open and convert iPhone HEIC photos.
when: the user uploads .heic files
how: pip install pillow-heif; from pillow_heif import register_heif_opener; register_heif_opener(); then Image.open('x.heic'). AVIF works natively in Pillow 12 (proven in MEDIA-09); HEIC was not tested.
